title: Small Compiler Subset BSBC Loader Independence
purpose: Give BSharp Compiler Subset 0 its own BSBC trust-boundary loader while preserving the production Ruby BytecodeLoader only as a separate referee for exact valid-model and malformed-artifact parity.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_bsbc_loader.rb as the independent Subset 0 BSBC loader
loading bytes produced by SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCEncoder without calling the production BytecodeLoader
using compiler/bytecode_loader.rb only on a separate referee path
requiring exact trusted-model, summary, fingerprint, and disassembly parity
requiring malformed-artifact rejection-message parity across a sealed mutation campaign
executing a model validated by SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCLoader through the BSharp VM execution engine
proving Profile 1 through Profile 7 compatibility without changing bytecode layout
forbidden_until_later_approval: inheriting SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCLoader from the production BytecodeLoader
routing normal BASIC# production loading through the subset loader

fixture.name: v076_independent_bsbc_loader_mixed
required_features: open close lock take object interaction

acceptance_rules: SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCLoader must not require, instantiate, inherit from, or call the production BytecodeLoader.
The production BytecodeLoader may remain loaded only for a separate referee comparison.
Valid independent-loader models, summaries, fingerprints, and disassembly must match the production referee exactly.
Every sealed malformed mutation must be rejected by both loaders with the same creator-facing error message.
A BSharp VM execution lane must run from a model validated by the independent subset loader.
The v0.1.76 dedicated fixture must mix inheritance, text, numbers, object interaction, IF/OTHERWISE, and selector families.
No Profile 8, binary-format change, full self-hosting claim, or Ruby retirement is allowed.
